== workflow env names ==
MISE_VERSION
== workflow defaults ==
run:
  shell: bash
== publish job env ==
MISE_AUTO_INSTALL: "false"
== publish job defaults ==
(none)
== jdx/mise-action inputs ==
version: ${{ env.MISE_VERSION }}
install_args: core:go
env: "false"
export_path: "false"
== Refuse anything but the daily slot or a manual run on main ==
env: EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
env: REF: ${{ github.ref }}
run:
case "${EVENT}" in
  schedule | workflow_dispatch) ;;
  *)
    echo "only the daily slot and a manual run publish, not a ${EVENT} run" >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac
if [ "${REF}" != refs/heads/main ]; then
  echo "only main publishes, not ${REF}" >&2
  exit 1
fi
== Refuse the template's image outside a rehearsal ==
env: IMAGE: ${{ inputs.image }}
env: REHEARSE: ${{ inputs.rehearse }}
run:
if [ "${IMAGE}" = ghcr.io/divbast/oci-image-template ] && [ "${REHEARSE}" != true ]; then
  echo "image is ghcr.io/divbast/oci-image-template, the template's, which publishes only in a rehearsal: set image to your app's own name" >&2
  exit 1
fi
== Refuse a rehearsal outside the template ==
run:
if [ "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" != divbast/oci-image-template ]; then
  line="only divbast/oci-image-template rehearses, not ${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}: to publish, set image to this app's own and remove rehearse from the job that calls app-publish.yml"
  echo "::error::${line}"
  echo "${line}" >> "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"
  exit 1
fi
line="rehearsal: nothing was published to ghcr.io"
echo "::warning::${line}"
echo "${line}" >> "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"
== Check the caller pins this commit of divbast/ci ==
env: WORKFLOW_SHA: ${{ job.workflow_sha }}
run:
mise exec -- go -C .ci build -o "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/.ci/bin/" ./cmd/...
.ci/bin/divbast-pin -expect "${WORKFLOW_SHA}"
== Decide whether to publish ==
env: EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
env: IMAGE: ${{ inputs.image }}
env: GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
run:
# actions/checkout points origin/main at the commit this run built,
# not at main's tip, so a newer published commit would read as one
# that is not on main. The repository is public; no credentials.
git fetch --no-tags --quiet origin +refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main
published=$(.ci/bin/divbast-published-revision "${IMAGE}:latest")
.ci/bin/divbast-publish-decision -event "${EVENT}" -built "${GITHUB_SHA}" -published "${published}"
== Start the rehearsal's registry ==
run:
# The password is rehearsal, hashed with bcrypt, which is all the
# registry reads
cat > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/rehearsal.htpasswd" <<'EOF'
rehearsal:$2y$05$EjEe94vjHWGY2fBH.Ugl6OucgCONUqj7tMeTnrww.QLljzQK06KEW
EOF
# renovate: registry
docker run -d -p 127.0.0.1:5000:5000 -v "${RUNNER_TEMP}/rehearsal.htpasswd:/auth/htpasswd:ro" -e REGISTRY_AUTH=htpasswd -e REGISTRY_AUTH_HTPASSWD_REALM=rehearsal -e REGISTRY_AUTH_HTPASSWD_PATH=/auth/htpasswd registry:<version>@<digest>
curl -fsS --retry 10 --retry-delay 1 --retry-all-errors -u rehearsal:rehearsal -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:5000/v2/
mkdir -p "${HOME}/.config/containers/registries.conf.d"
printf '[[registry]]\nlocation = "localhost:5000"\ninsecure = true\n' \
  > "${HOME}/.config/containers/registries.conf.d/rehearsal.conf"
echo rehearsal | docker login --username rehearsal --password-stdin localhost:5000
== Read the version from the Containerfile ==
env: VERSION_ARG: ${{ inputs.version-arg }}
run:
if [[ ! "${VERSION_ARG}" =~ ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$ ]]; then
  echo "version-arg must name an ARG, not ${VERSION_ARG}" >&2
  exit 1
fi
v=$(sed -n "s/^ARG ${VERSION_ARG}=//p" Containerfile)
if [[ ! "${v}" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,127}$ ]]; then
  echo "Containerfile has no one ARG ${VERSION_ARG}= line whose value can tag an image" >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "version=${v}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
== Choose where to publish ==
env: IMAGE: ${{ inputs.image }}
env: REHEARSE: ${{ inputs.rehearse }}
run:
if [ "${REHEARSE}" = true ]; then
  echo "image=localhost:5000/${IMAGE#*/}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
else
  echo "image=${IMAGE}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
fi
== Push each tested architecture ==
env: IMAGE: ${{ steps.target.outputs.image }}
env: VERSION: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
run:
for arch in amd64 arm64; do
  skopeo copy --all \
    --digestfile "/tmp/digest-${arch}" \
    --dest-authfile "${HOME}/.docker/config.json" \
    "oci-archive:/tmp/images/image-${arch}/image.tar" \
    "docker://${IMAGE}:${VERSION}-${arch}"
done
== Merge the architectures into one index under a staging tag ==
env: IMAGE: ${{ steps.target.outputs.image }}
env: VERSION: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
env: DESCRIPTION: ${{ inputs.description }}
run:
created=$(date -u -d "@$(git log -1 --pretty=%ct)" +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
docker buildx imagetools create \
  --metadata-file /tmp/index.json \
  --annotation "index:org.opencontainers.image.version=${VERSION}" \
  --annotation "index:org.opencontainers.image.revision=${GITHUB_SHA}" \
  --annotation "index:org.opencontainers.image.created=${created}" \
  --annotation "index:org.opencontainers.image.description=${DESCRIPTION}" \
  -t "${IMAGE}:${VERSION}-staging" \
  "${IMAGE}@$(cat /tmp/digest-amd64)" \
  "${IMAGE}@$(cat /tmp/digest-arm64)"
digest=$(jq -er '."containerimage.descriptor".digest' /tmp/index.json)
echo "digest=${digest}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
== Verify the index's attestation ==
env: IMAGE: ${{ steps.target.outputs.image }}
env: DIGEST: ${{ steps.merge.outputs.digest }}
env: REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
env: GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
run:
skopeo inspect --raw "docker://${IMAGE}@${DIGEST}" > /tmp/index-manifest.json
fetched=$(shasum -a 256 < /tmp/index-manifest.json)
if [ "sha256:${fetched%% *}" != "${DIGEST}" ]; then
  echo "${IMAGE}@${DIGEST} came back as bytes whose digest is sha256:${fetched%% *}" >&2
  exit 1
fi
empty=$(mktemp -d)
verify() {
  DOCKER_CONFIG="${empty}" gh attestation verify /tmp/index-manifest.json \
    --repo "${REPO}" \
    --signer-workflow divbast/ci/.github/workflows/app-publish.yml \
    --source-ref refs/heads/main \
    --format json > /tmp/verified.json
}
# Three tries, ten seconds apart, for an attestation made moments
# ago that the API does not return yet
verify || { sleep 10 && verify; } || { sleep 10 && verify; }
# For the log alone: gh's exit status is the verdict
signer=$(jq -r '(.[0].verificationResult.signature.certificate.buildSignerURI)? // "unknown"' /tmp/verified.json) ||
  signer=unknown
echo "${IMAGE}@${DIGEST} verifies, signed by ${signer}"
== Tag the attested index with the version and latest ==
env: IMAGE: ${{ steps.target.outputs.image }}
env: VERSION: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
env: DIGEST: ${{ steps.merge.outputs.digest }}
run:
args=(
  -t "${IMAGE}:${VERSION}"
  -t "${IMAGE}:latest"
  "${IMAGE}@${DIGEST}"
)
docker buildx imagetools create --dry-run "${args[@]}" > /tmp/promoted.json
size=$(wc -c < /tmp/promoted.json)
would=$(head -c "$((size - 1))" /tmp/promoted.json | shasum -a 256)
if [ "sha256:${would%% *}" != "${DIGEST}" ]; then
  echo "imagetools would tag sha256:${would%% *}, not ${DIGEST}, the index attested" >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "moving=true" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
docker buildx imagetools create "${args[@]}"
== Check both tags are the attested index as users pull them ==
env: IMAGE: ${{ steps.target.outputs.image }}
env: VERSION: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
env: DIGEST: ${{ steps.merge.outputs.digest }}
env: ANONYMOUS: ${{ !inputs.rehearse }}
run:
creds=(--no-creds)
who="an anonymous client"
if [ "${ANONYMOUS}" = false ]; then
  creds=()
  who="the job's login"
fi
for tag in "${VERSION}" latest; do
  if ! pulled=$(skopeo inspect --raw "${creds[@]}" "docker://${IMAGE}:${tag}" | shasum -a 256) ||
    [ "sha256:${pulled%% *}" != "${DIGEST}" ]; then
    echo "${IMAGE}:${tag} is not ${DIGEST} to ${who}" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "${IMAGE}:${tag} is ${DIGEST} to ${who}"
done
== Say that the public tags did not move ==
env: VERSION: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
run:
echo "::error::the public tags :${VERSION:-<version>} and :latest did not move." \
  "Re-running the failed job publishes for a day after this run built its images, while their artifacts last," \
  "unless a newer image has been published since; after that, the next daily slot or a manual run publishes."
